fonts.display: 'FK Raster Grotesk Compact Trial Sharp', ui-sans-serif, system-ui, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, "Segoe UI", Roboto, sans-serif
fonts.body: 'IBM Plex Mono', ui-monospace, SFMono-Regular, Menlo, Monaco, Consolas, monospace

palette.name: Acid Lime
palette.role: Green action color for filled buttons, selected navigation states, and focused conversion moments

palette.name: Obsidian
palette.role: Body and heading text, dominant border color, dark section canvas — near-pure black for maximum contrast

palette.name: Pure Black
palette.role: High-frequency borders, icons, decorative strokes, image outlines — the structural black that outlines every other element

palette.name: Bone White
palette.role: Light section canvas, card surfaces, inverted text on dark sections and lime buttons

palette.name: Fog
palette.role: Placeholder surfaces, muted image backgrounds, subtle borders, disabled state fills

palette.name: Slate
palette.role: Secondary dark surfaces, dark mode card backgrounds, subdued text on dark canvases
